name: Volumetric Sensor for Differentiable Rendering
definition: A sensor implementation for differentiable rendering that accumulates radiance contributions into a volumetric film using delta tracking or similar path tracing logic, supporting both forward and reverse-mode automatic differentiation.
summary: The Volumetric Sensor is a differentiable rendering component that accumulates radiance into a volumetric film using delta tracking, explicitly managing gradient propagation through scattering and extinction coefficients.
